title: Triple passage: Conference program, registration page, and e-mail
passage:
【Document 1: Program】
Northbridge Logistics Forum — October 14
Harbor Convention Center, Hall B
9:00 A.M. Keynote: "The Future of Last-Mile Delivery" — Dana Whitfield, CEO, Swiftline
10:30 A.M. Panel: Warehouse Automation on a Budget
1:00 P.M. Workshop: Reducing Fuel Costs (limited to 30 participants)
3:00 P.M. Panel: Hiring and Keeping Drivers
4:30 P.M. Networking reception (Hall C)
Each session lasts about 75 minutes and includes time for questions from the audience. The keynote will explore how retailers are adapting to customers who expect same-day delivery. The automation panel will feature three companies that installed low-cost robotic systems in mid-sized warehouses. The fuel workshop will cover route planning, vehicle maintenance schedules, and the use of data to reduce idling time. The driver panel will discuss training programs, flexible schedules, and benefits that help companies keep experienced drivers. Printed handouts will be available at the registration desk in the main lobby on the morning of the forum. Dana Whitfield has led Swiftline since 2015, and she previously managed distribution centers for a national retailer. The forum has been held every autumn for more than ten years. Lunch will be served buffet-style in Hall A from 12:00 P.M. to 1:00 P.M., and vegetarian meals are available on request. Speakers will share their slides, which attendees can download from the forum website after the event. Seating in the workshops is limited, so participants should arrive at least ten minutes early to check in. Attendees who need a receipt for their company can request one at the registration desk.

【Document 2: Web page】
Registration Fees
Full-day pass: $180 (includes lunch and the networking reception)
Morning or afternoon pass: $95 (lunch not included)
Group discount: Organizations registering four or more people receive 15% off each full-day pass.
Note: Workshop seats must be reserved separately at no extra charge. Registration closes October 7. Groups must submit one registration form listing the name and e-mail address of each attendee. Attendees will receive a name badge and a conference bag at the registration desk. Payment can be made by credit card or, for organizations, by invoice. Cancellations made before October 1 will be refunded in full, minus a $20 processing fee. Organizations that cancel after October 1 may transfer their passes to another employee at no charge, provided the name is sent to the registration desk by October 10.

【Document 3: E-mail】
From: Marcus Lee <mlee@carrowfreight.com>
To: registration@northbridgeforum.org
Date: October 2
Subject: Group registration

Hello,
I would like to register four employees of Carrow Freight for full-day passes. Our operations manager, Priya Nair, is particularly interested in the session on fuel costs, so please reserve a seat for her. The others will attend the afternoon panel instead. We attended last year and found the sessions very useful. Ms. Nair has been leading our project to reduce fuel use on our delivery routes, so the workshop will be especially valuable to her. Please send one invoice for all four passes to our accounts department. Could you also confirm whether parking is available at the convention center? Two of our staff will be driving from our Eastfield office. Thank you for your help, and I look forward to seeing the program in person.
Best regards,
Marcus Lee
translation:
【文書1:プログラム】ノースブリッジ物流フォーラム 10月14日/ハーバー・コンベンションセンター ホールB/午前9時 基調講演「ラストワンマイル配送の未来」ダナ・ウィットフィールド(スウィフトライン社CEO)/午前10時30分 パネル:低予算での倉庫自動化/午後1時 ワークショップ:燃料費の削減(定員30名)/午後3時 パネル:運転手の採用と定着/午後4時30分 交流会(ホールC)/各セッションは約75分で、会場からの質問の時間も含む。基調講演では、当日配送を求める顧客に小売業者がどう対応しているかを掘り下げる。自動化のパネルでは、中規模の倉庫に低コストのロボットシステムを導入した3社が登壇する。燃料費のワークショップでは、経路計画、車両の整備計画、アイドリング時間を減らすためのデータ活用を扱う。運転手のパネルでは、研修制度、柔軟な勤務時間、経験豊富な運転手を引き留める福利厚生について話し合う。当日朝は、資料をメインロビーの受付で配布する。ダナ・ウィットフィールドは2015年からスウィフトラインを率いており、それ以前は全国展開の小売業者で物流センターを管理していた。このフォーラムは10年以上、毎年秋に開催されている。昼食は12時から1時まで、ホールAでビュッフェ形式で出される。ベジタリアン向けの食事は事前に頼めばある。講演者のスライドは、終了後にフォーラムの公式サイトからダウンロードできる。ワークショップの席は限られているので、受付は開始の10分前までに済ませてほしい。会社用に領収書が必要な参加者は、受付で依頼できる。

【文書2:ウェブページ】参加費/1日券180ドル(昼食と交流会を含む)/午前券・午後券95ドル(昼食なし)/団体割引:4名以上で申し込む団体は1日券がそれぞれ15%引き/注:ワークショップの席は追加料金なしで別途予約が必要。申し込み締め切りは10月7日。団体で申し込む場合は、参加者全員の氏名とメールアドレスを記載した申込書を1通提出する。受付で名札と会議用バッグを受け取れる。支払いはクレジットカード、または組織の場合は請求書払い。10月1日より前に取り消した場合は、事務手数料20ドルを差し引いて全額返金する。10月1日以降に取り消す組織は、10月10日までに受付へ名前を知らせれば、追加料金なしで別の社員に参加券を譲渡できる。

【文書3:メール】キャロウ・フレイト社の社員4名の1日券を申し込みたい。業務部長のプリヤ・ネアは燃料費のセッションに特に関心があるので席を予約してほしい。他の者は代わりに午後のパネルに出る。昨年参加して講演がとても役立ったので、今年も楽しみにしている。ネアさんは当社の配送ルートの燃料使用を減らすプロジェクトを主導しているので、そのワークショップは彼女にとって特に有益だろう。4名分の1日券は1通の請求書にまとめ、経理部宛てに送ってほしい。コンベンションセンターに駐車場があるかも確認してほしい。2名がイーストフィールド事務所から車で来る。手配にお礼を申し上げます。当日の講演を楽しみにしています。マーカス・リー

choices: The head of a delivery company
questions.explanation: プログラムに、基調講演者ダナ・ウィットフィールドはスウィフトライン社のCEOとある。基調講演の題名から配送の会社と分かる。

questions.explanation: メールで4名の1日券を申し込んでおり、ウェブページの団体割引(4名以上で1日券15%引き)が適用される。180ドルの15%引きで153ドル。2つの文書を合わせて判断する。

questions.question: What session will Ms. Nair attend at 1:00 P.M.?
choices: A workshop on reducing fuel costs
questions.explanation: メールでネアさんは燃料費のセッションに関心があるとあり、プログラムでは午後1時が燃料費削減のワークショップ。

choices: Participants must reserve a seat in advance.
It takes place in Hall C.

questions.explanation: ウェブページに、ワークショップの席は追加料金なしで別途予約が必要とある。定員30名でもある。交流会がホールC。

title: Triple passage: Product catalog, order form, and shipping notice
passage:
【Document 1: Catalog page】
Brightdesk Office Chairs
Model A20 — Basic task chair, black fabric — $129
Model A40 — Ergonomic chair with adjustable arms, black or gray mesh — $219
Model A60 — Executive chair, leather, headrest included — $349
All chairs come with a five-year warranty. Orders of ten or more chairs ship free of charge; otherwise, a flat shipping fee of $45 applies.
Assembly is not required for any model, so chairs arrive fully assembled and ready to use. Model A40 chairs include a lumbar support adjustment and a tilt lock, while Model A60 chairs have a high back with padded armrests. Bulk pricing is available for purchases of 25 or more chairs; please request a quote from a sales representative. Our customer service team is available Monday through Friday, 8:00 A.M. to 6:00 P.M., to answer questions about sizing and availability. Chairs are shipped in cartons with protective packaging, and the company offers free returns within 30 days if a chair does not meet your expectations. Every model is available with optional floor glides for hard surfaces at no extra cost. Orders to remote areas may take three additional business days, and customer service can confirm estimated arrival dates. Each chair is inspected for scratches and loose parts before it leaves the warehouse, and a tag with the model name and color is attached to the back of every chair. Customers who order by the end of the month can also choose a delivery window between 8:00 A.M. and 4:00 P.M.

Contact: Teresa Ortiz
Date: March 3

The chairs will be used by new staff who joined the firm in January, and the firm plans to order more chairs for its conference room later this year. Please confirm receipt by e-mail once the chairs have been unloaded and inspected. The office manager will sign for the delivery, and the loading dock is open from 8:00 A.M. until 5:00 P.M. on weekdays.

【Document 3: Shipping notice】

Order #5521
We are pleased to inform you that your order has shipped. Unfortunately, the Model A40 in gray is temporarily out of stock, so we have sent the black version at no extra cost, as you agreed by phone on March 5. Your order is scheduled to arrive on March 11. If you have any questions, contact our customer service team at 555-0182. The Model A60 executive chair is packed in the same shipment. A copy of the warranty card is enclosed with each chair. For assembly questions, please see the online guide. Thank you for choosing Brightdesk, and we look forward to serving your office again. Our quality team inspected each box before dispatch, and returns are accepted within 30 days with pickup arranged at no cost. Please keep the original packaging for at least 14 days, as it helps our team process returns quickly.

title: Triple passage: Restaurant review, menu, and e-mail
passage:
【Document 1: Online review】
Copper Kettle Bistro ★★★★☆
Posted by J. Reyes, May 20
I had lunch at the Copper Kettle with two colleagues last Thursday. The roasted vegetable soup was the highlight—rich and full of flavor. My grilled salmon was cooked perfectly, though the portion was smaller than I expected for the price. Service was friendly but slow; we waited almost 25 minutes for our main dishes. The private room upstairs looks ideal for business meetings, and I plan to book it for my team's next lunch. The restaurant was busy, so I would suggest calling ahead for a table. The warm bread basket and the iced tea were both refreshing. The large windows on Copper Street make the dining room bright in the afternoon, and the staff were happy to adjust the lighting for our group. I would recommend the bistro for small team lunches, though I hope the kitchen can speed up service during busy hours. Overall I would give it four stars, and I would order the soup again without hesitation. The bistro is on Copper Street, a short walk from the train station, which makes it convenient for our office. There is also a small outdoor patio that will be lovely in summer. The restaurant also offers takeout for office meetings, which may be useful for future events.

【Document 2: Menu】
Copper Kettle Bistro — Lunch Menu (11:30 A.M.–2:30 P.M.)
Soup of the day — $7
Garden salad — $9
Grilled salmon with rice — $22
Chicken pasta — $17
Vegetable curry — $15
Private room (up to 12 guests): available for lunch with a minimum order of $200.
Groups of 8 or more may order from a set menu of $28 per person, which includes soup, a main dish, and dessert. The main dish on the set menu may be salmon, chicken pasta, or vegetable curry, and the dessert of the day is served to everyone. Gluten-free dishes can be prepared with advance notice to the kitchen. Coffee and tea are included with every lunch set. Desserts are available for an additional $6 each, except on the set menu. Private room bookings are confirmed by a staff member within two business days. Vegetarian options are marked on the menu with a leaf symbol, and the restaurant is closed on Sundays and public holidays.

【Document 3: E-mail】
From: Julia Reyes
To: events@copperkettlebistro.com
Date: June 2
Subject: Private room reservation

Hello,
I would like to reserve your private room for lunch on June 18 at 12:00 for a group of ten. We would like to order the set menu. Because we have a meeting at 1:30, it is important that the food is served promptly. Our group is from the sales department, and this will be our first lunch at the restaurant, so we would like the room set up with one large round table. We will confirm the final headcount by June 10, and we will need the bill divided into two payments, one for the set menu and one for drinks. The room should also be ready by 11:45 A.M. so that our guests can settle in before the meal starts. Could you also let me know whether you can prepare a gluten-free option for one guest?
Thank you,
Julia Reyes
translation:
【文書1:オンラインレビュー】カッパー・ケトル・ビストロ 星4つ/J・レイエス 5月20日/先週木曜日、同僚2人と昼食をとった。ロースト野菜のスープが一番で、濃厚で風味豊かだった。グリルしたサーモンは完璧に焼けていたが、値段の割に量が少なかった。接客は感じが良いが遅く、メインまで25分近く待った。2階の個室は商談に理想的に見えるので、チームの次の昼食に予約するつもりだ。店は混んでいたので、席は事前に電話で予約したほうがよい。温かいパンのかごとアイスティーもさわやかだった。カッパー通りに面した大きな窓のおかげで昼間の店内は明るく、スタッフは私たちのグループのために照明を調整してくれた。小規模なチームのランチにはお勧めだが、混雑時には厨房がもう少し早く料理を出せるとよい。全体では星4つで、スープはまた迷わず注文したい。カッパー通りにあり、駅から歩いてすぐなので会社からも便利だ。夏にはきれいな屋外のテラス席もある。会議用のテイクアウトも行っており、今後の社内行事にも役立ちそうだ。

【文書2:メニュー】ランチ(午前11時30分〜午後2時30分)/本日のスープ7ドル/ガーデンサラダ9ドル/サーモンのグリルとライス22ドル/チキンパスタ17ドル/野菜カレー15ドル/個室(12名まで):昼食時、最低200ドルの注文で利用可/8名以上はスープ・メイン・デザート付きの1人28ドルのセットメニューを注文可。セットのメイン料理はサーモン、チキンパスタ、野菜カレーから選べ、デザートは日替わりで全員に出される。グルテンフリーの料理は事前に厨房へ知らせれば用意できる。コーヒーと紅茶はどのランチセットにも付く。デザートは単品で1つ6ドル追加(セットメニューを除く)。個室の予約は営業日2日以内にスタッフから確認の連絡が入る。ベジタリアン向けの料理はメニューに葉のマークで示され、日曜と祝日は休業。

【文書3:メール】6月18日12時に10名で個室を予約したい。セットメニューを注文したい。1時30分に会議があるので料理をすぐ出してもらうことが重要。当社は営業部のグループで、この店での昼食は今回が初めてなので、個室には大きな丸テーブルを1つ用意してほしい。最終人数は6月10日までに確認する。会計は2つに分けてほしく、セットメニュー分と飲み物分にしてほしい。個室は11時45分までに準備しておいてほしい。食事の前に客が落ち着けるようにしたい。1人分グルテンフリーの料理を用意できるかも教えてほしい。ジュリア・レイエス

title: Triple passage: Course list, e-mail, and invoice
passage:
【Document 1: Course list】
Pinecrest Professional Training — Autumn Courses
Project Management Basics — 3 sessions, Mondays, Sept. 8–22 — $240
Business Writing for Managers — 2 sessions, Wednesdays, Sept. 10–17 — $180
Data Visualization with Spreadsheets — 4 sessions, Thursdays, Sept. 11–Oct. 2 — $320
Negotiation Skills — 1 full-day session, Saturday, Sept. 20 — $150
Early registration: Enroll by August 25 and receive 10% off any course.
Project Management Basics covers planning, scheduling, and budget tracking, with a case study in each session. Business Writing for Managers focuses on memos, reports, and clear e-mails for busy teams. Data Visualization with Spreadsheets teaches participants to build charts and dashboards from raw sales data. Negotiation Skills is a single intensive day with role-play exercises and practice with difficult clients. All courses are held at the Pinecrest Training Center on Harbor Road, and participants receive a certificate after attending at least 80 percent of the sessions. Fees include all course materials and a light breakfast on the first day of each course. Class sizes are limited to 20 people per session, so early registration is recommended. Participants may also attend a free orientation on the first Monday of September, where they can meet instructors and review course schedules; attendance is optional. The course coordinator is available by phone on weekdays to answer questions about schedules, prerequisites, and course materials. Participants who miss a session can review recorded materials in the online learning portal within one week.

【Document 2: E-mail】
From: Kenji Mori
To: info@pinecresttraining.com
Date: August 28
Subject: Course enrollment

Dear Pinecrest Training,

Subject: Maple Court, Unit 4B

Hello,
I am interested in the apartment listed at Maple Court. My partner and I both drive to work, so we would need two parking spaces. We also have a small, very quiet dog. Would it be possible to make an exception to the pet policy? Finally, I start a new job in the city on July 15, so I would prefer a move-in date close to that. We have lived in the city for several years and would like to stay in the same neighborhood, so Maple Court's location is ideal for us. We have been looking for several weeks and have seen many listings, but few allow pets or have two parking spaces. Our dog is well trained and has lived with us for six years. We are hoping to hear back this week, since we need to plan our move carefully.
Thank you,
Amara Okafor

Please let me know if you would like to see it this weekend.
Sincerely,
Peter Halvorsen

title: Triple passage: Press release, article, and online comment
passage:
【Document 1: Press release】
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE — April 3
Greenway Foods to Open Its First Store in Riverton
Greenway Foods, a regional grocery chain known for its locally grown produce, will open a 2,000-square-meter store on Elm Avenue on May 15. The store will create approximately 60 jobs and will feature a café, a bakery, and a weekend farmers' market in its parking lot. Hiring events will be held at the Riverton Community Center on April 12 and 19. The store will offer more than 3,000 products, with a focus on produce from farms within 100 kilometers of Riverton. Greenway Foods was founded in 1998 and currently operates 14 stores in neighboring counties. Store hours will be 7:00 A.M. to 10:00 P.M. daily. "We are proud to bring fresh, local food to Riverton," said company president David Greenway. Greenway Foods will also donate unsold bread to local food banks at the end of each day, and it plans to expand its bakery team later this year. The company also plans a community event this summer with local musicians, which will be announced later. A delivery service for customers within the city will begin at the Riverton store in June.

【Document 2: Article】
Riverton Daily — May 16
Crowds Greet New Grocery Store
Hundreds of shoppers lined up outside the new Greenway Foods store on Elm Avenue yesterday morning. Store manager Elena Petrov said the company had hired 72 local residents, more than originally planned, because of strong interest at its hiring events. The weekend farmers' market, however, will not begin until June because several vendors needed more time to prepare. Some nearby residents have expressed concern about increased traffic on Elm Avenue. The city council will review a request for a new traffic light at the Elm Avenue intersection next month. Shoppers also praised the wide selection of organic products and the friendly staff, and Ms. Petrov said the store may extend its hours if demand continues. Store manager Elena Petrov also noted that the bakery has been busy since the first morning, and the produce section is restocked twice a day. The store also installed electric vehicle charging stations in its parking lot, although only four are currently available. Several shoppers said they would return once the farmers' market opens.

【Document 3: Online comment】
Posted by Tom W., May 17
I visited Greenway on its first day. The produce section is excellent, and the bakery sells the best bread in town. My only complaint is the parking lot, which was completely full when I arrived. I ended up parking on a side street. Once the farmers' market starts in the same lot, I expect parking will be even harder on weekends. The cashiers were quick, and I was in and out in fifteen minutes. I will definitely return, although I would arrive early on weekends. The staff were friendly, and the coffee was excellent. Next time I will try the weekend bread, which I heard sells out quickly. Overall, I would recommend Greenway to anyone living nearby, and I hope management solves the parking problem soon.
translation:
【文書1:プレスリリース】4月3日/グリーンウェイ・フーズがリバートンに初出店/地元産の農産物で知られる地域のスーパーチェーンであるグリーンウェイ・フーズは、5月15日にエルム通りに2,000平方メートルの店舗を開店する。約60人の雇用を生み、カフェ、ベーカリー、駐車場での週末のファーマーズマーケットを備える。採用説明会は4月12日と19日にリバートン・コミュニティセンターで開催。店では3,000点以上の商品を扱い、リバートンから100キロメートル以内の農場で採れた農産物に力を入れる。グリーンウェイ・フーズは1998年に創業し、現在は近隣の郡に14店舗を展開している。営業時間は毎日午前7時から午後10時まで。「地元の新鮮な食品をリバートンに届けられることを誇りに思う」と、社長のデイビッド・グリーンウェイは語った。また、売れ残りのパンは毎日閉店後に地元のフードバンクへ寄付され、今年後半にはベーカリーのチームも拡大する予定だ。夏には地元の音楽家を招いた地域イベントも計画しており、詳細は後日発表される。市内の顧客向けの配達サービスは6月からリバートン店で始まる。

【文書2:記事】5月16日/新しいスーパーを群衆が歓迎/昨日の朝、何百人もの買い物客がエルム通りの新しいグリーンウェイ・フーズの前に並んだ。店長のエレナ・ペトロフによると、採用説明会での関心が高かったため、当初の計画より多い72人の地元住民を雇った。ただし週末のファーマーズマーケットは、いくつかの出店者の準備に時間がかかるため6月まで始まらない。近隣住民の中にはエルム通りの交通量の増加を懸念する声もある。市議会は来月、エルム通りの交差点に新しい信号機を設置する要望を検討する予定だ。買い物客からは有機食品の品ぞろえの豊富さや店員の親切さも好評だった。ペトロフ店長は、需要が続けば営業時間を延長するかもしれないと話した。ペトロフ店長はまた、ベーカリーは初日の朝から忙しく、青果売り場は1日2回補充していると説明した。店の駐車場には電気自動車の充電器も設置されたが、現在使えるのは4か所だけだ。ファーマーズマーケットが始まったら戻ってくると話す買い物客も何人かいた。

【文書3:オンラインコメント】初日に行った。青果売り場は素晴らしく、ベーカリーのパンは町で一番。唯一の不満は駐車場で、着いたときには満車だった。結局脇道に停めた。同じ駐車場でファーマーズマーケットが始まれば、週末の駐車はさらに難しくなると思う。レジは速く、15分で買い物を終えられた。また必ず来たいが、週末は早めに来るつもりだ。店員は親切で、コーヒーもおいしかった。次は週末のパンを試したい。週末のパンはすぐ売り切れると聞いた。近所の人にはグリーンウェイを勧めたいが、駐車場の問題は早く解決してほしい。

【文書2:予約確認】予約番号SR-8841/顧客:ダニエル・コワルスキ/車種:ミニバン/貸出:空港営業所、8月3日午前10時/返却:ダウンタウン営業所、8月6日午後6時/追加:追加運転者(マリア・コワルスキ)/運転者全員の有効な運転免許証を持参のこと。同行者は6名で荷物も多い。4482便は午前9時30分に到着するので、一行は午前10時までに貸出カウンターに着いている予定。お客様の連絡先は555-0139。借りる人名義のクレジットカードが必要で、返却まで200ドルのデポジットが預けられる。コワルスキ様はミニバンを引き取り前に清掃してほしいと依頼し、スタッフが電話で確認した。マリア・コワルスキ様は、有効な免許を持ち、レンタカーの運転経験もあるので、帰りの運転者になる予定。便名の情報は、予定変更に備えて記録しておく。一行は空港の出口近くに車を停めてもらい、荷物を積みやすくしたいとのこと。

【文書3:領収書】ダウンタウン営業所/8月6日/ミニバン4日356ドル/追加運転者4日40ドル/乗り捨て料金60ドル/燃料代35ドル/合計491ドル/注:満タンでない状態で返却。支払いはVisaカード(末尾4418)で行われた。返却時の点検で新たな損傷は見つからなかった。サミット・レンタカーをご利用いただきありがとうございます。記録のため領収書は保管してください。支払いは返却日に処理された。貸出時の燃料は満タンと記録されていた。契約書の控えはダウンタウン営業所の店長に依頼すれば入手できる。請求に関する質問もダウンタウン営業所へどうぞ。サミットをご利用いただきありがとうございました。次の旅行でもまたご利用ください。請求内容に異議がある場合、返金には営業日5日ほどかかる。

title: Triple passage: Memo, floor plan, and e-mail about an office renovation
passage:
【Document 1: Memo】
To: All staff, Fenwick Design Studio
From: Rachel Kim, Office Manager
Date: February 10
Subject: Third-floor renovation

Renovation work on the third floor will take place from March 3 to March 21. During this period, the design team will move to temporary desks on the second floor, and the third-floor kitchen will be closed. Staff may use the second-floor kitchen instead. Please pack personal items from your desk by February 28. Boxes will be delivered to each team on February 24. The renovation will add new lighting, updated desks, and a larger kitchen on the third floor. Please remove any plants, photographs, or fragile items from your workspace before the boxes arrive, and label each box with your name and team. The front reception desk will remain open throughout the renovation, and building staff will answer questions about access. Thank you for your patience. Each team will receive a labeled storage bin for small items, and the bins must be returned to the supply room by March 25. Staff are welcome to visit the temporary workspace on February 27 to ask questions before the move. The renovation is expected to finish on schedule, and any delays will be announced by e-mail. Please direct any questions about the move to the office manager, who will also confirm the final date for returning empty boxes.

【Document 2: Floor plan】
Second Floor (temporary layout, March 3–21)
Room 201: Accounting
Room 202: Design team (temporary)
Room 203: Meeting room A (book through the online calendar)
Room 204: Kitchen
Room 205: Storage — boxes from the third floor
Room 206: Restrooms (open to all staff). Room 207: Reception and lounge area. Rooms 201 and 203 are shared with other departments and must be booked in advance. Printers for the temporary layout are located next to Room 204, and each room has a whiteboard and wall display. Additional chairs can be requested from the office manager. The second-floor layout will remain in place until March 21, and rooms will return to normal use the following Monday. Shared kitchen appliances on the second floor will be cleaned each evening.

【Document 3: E-mail】
From: Oliver Grant
To: Rachel Kim
Date: February 26
Subject: Renovation question

Hi Rachel,
I have a client presentation scheduled for March 12 in the third-floor meeting room. Since that room will not be available, I would like to move the presentation to the second floor. I tried to book the room there through the online calendar, but it says the room is already reserved that afternoon. The client has already seen our design proposal and expects a full review, so the room must seat eight people and have a working projector. Could you help me find another option? Also, my team still hasn't received the boxes for packing. We have been preparing the slides for two weeks, and if we cannot use the second-floor room, the client may need to visit our downtown office instead. I would also appreciate any advice about the printed handouts, which are stored in our team's locked cabinet on the third floor. Our team has been working on this project for three months, and the client has a strict schedule. If you could reply by Friday, I would be grateful, so I can update the client before the end of the week.
Thanks,
Oliver
translation:
【文書1:社内連絡】宛先:フェンウィック・デザイン・スタジオ全社員/差出人:レイチェル・キム(総務)/2月10日/件名:3階の改装/3階の改装工事を3月3日から21日まで行う。この期間、デザインチームは2階の仮の席に移り、3階の給湯室は閉鎖する。代わりに2階の給湯室を使ってよい。2月28日までに机の私物を箱詰めすること。箱は2月24日に各チームに届けられる。改装後は、照明を新しくし、机も入れ替え、3階の給湯室も広くなる。箱が届く前に、机の植物や写真、壊れやすいものを片付け、箱には名前とチーム名を書いてほしい。改装期間中も正面の受付は開いており、建物の担当者が入退室について質問に答える。ご協力に感謝します。各チームには小物用の仮の収納ボックスが1つ渡され、ボックスは3月25日までに備品室へ返却すること。移動前に質問があれば、2月27日に仮の作業場所を見に来てよい。改装は予定どおり完了する見込みで、遅れがあればメールで知らせる。移動に関する質問はオフィスマネージャーへ。空き箱の返却期限も担当者が確認する。

【文書2:フロア図】2階(仮の配置、3月3〜21日)/201号室:経理/202号室:デザインチーム(仮)/203号室:会議室A(オンラインカレンダーで予約)/204号室:給湯室/205号室:倉庫(3階からの箱)/206号室:トイレ(全社員が利用可)/207号室:受付兼休憩スペース/201号室と203号室は他の部署と共用のため、事前予約が必要。仮の配置のプリンターは204号室(給湯室)の隣にあり、各部屋にホワイトボードと壁面ディスプレイがある。追加の椅子はオフィスマネージャーに頼める。2階の仮の配置は3月21日まで続き、翌週の月曜から各部屋は通常どおり使える。2階の共用の調理器具は毎晩清掃される。

【文書3:メール】3月12日に3階の会議室で顧客へのプレゼンを予定している。その部屋は使えないので2階に移したい。オンラインカレンダーで2階の部屋を予約しようとしたが、その日の午後はすでに予約済みと表示される。顧客はデザイン案をすでに見ており、本格的な検討を求めているので、部屋は8名が座れてプロジェクターが使えることが必要だ。別の方法を探すのを手伝ってほしい。また、私のチームはまだ箱詰め用の箱を受け取っていない。このプレゼンのスライドは2週間かけて準備してきた。2階の部屋が使えない場合、顧客にダウンタウンの事務所まで来てもらうことになるかもしれない。また、配布する印刷物の保管についても助言がほしい。印刷物は3階にあるチームの鍵付きキャビネットに入っている。このプロジェクトは3か月取り組んできたし、顧客の日程も厳しい。金曜までに返事をもらえればありがたく、週末前に顧客へ連絡できる。オリバー
